build_trainer: build a Trainer instance for data parallel training across multiple GPUs with a model, criterion, and task
train_step: run a training step that performs forward, backward pass and parameter update on a batch of samples
valid_step: run a validation step that performs a forward pass in evaluation mode and aggregates metrics
save_checkpoint: save all training state including model, optimizer, and meters to a checkpoint file
load_checkpoint: load training state from a checkpoint file and restore model, optimizer, and learning rate scheduler
